ios.desc:
Get instant AI feedback on your deadlift form. Upload a video, and Strength AI analyzes every rep —
  telling you exactly what's right, what's wrong, and how to lift safer.

  WHAT IT DOES
  • Import your deadlift video
  • AI analyzes your form rep by rep
  • Get a score from 0–100 for each set
  • Identify issues like hip shoot, back rounding, and poor setup

  WHY LIFTERS USE IT
  • Know when your form is solid enough to add weight
  • Catch bad reps before they lead to injury
  • Track your form over time and see improvement
  • Get feedback that would cost $100+/hr from a coach

  HOW IT WORKS
  1. Import a side-angle video of your deadlift
  2. The AI processes your video and detects each rep
  3. Review your score, rep breakdown, and specific form issues

  FEATURES
  • Form issue detection: hip shoot, back drift, lumbar rounding, jerky pull, setup risk
  • Overall score with color-coded assessment
  • Scan history to track progress over time
  • Premium: sync your history across devices
  • Premium:: analyze more then one video

  Built for lifters who take strength training seriously. Whether you train alone or want a second opinion
   on your form — Strength AI has your back (literally).

  Download now and check your next set.

Privacy Policy: https://myclok.com/apps/strength-ai/privacy
Terms of use: https://myclok.com/apps/strength-ai/terms-and-conditions
